portInfo.description: Livorno is Tuscany's main port and one of the Mediterranean's best examples of a "gateway" call: few passengers come for Livorno itself, yet its canals, Medici fortresses and seafront Terrazza Mascagni make a pleasant low-stress day. The real decision is how far inland to go. Pisa's Field of Miracles is close and simple by train; Florence is a full commitment with two train legs, a bus or taxi and a shuttle each way. The terminal operator, Porto di Livorno 2000, runs the Alto Fondale terminal at quays 46/47, opened in 2013 for ships over 300 m.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Alto Fondale Cruise Terminal — Quay 46/47, Port of Livorno

Exact shuttle frequency/fares: not verified from a primary operator page this repair. 2. Town → Livorno Centrale: LAM BLU bus or walk via Via Grande — walking minutes previously quoted from secondary cruise guides are withdrawn until checked on the ground; treat as unverified. 3. Trains: check Trenitalia (or regional operator) for your call date for Livorno Centrale ↔ Pisa Centrale ↔ Firenze S.M. Novella. Published secondary summaries suggested Pisa ~13–20 min and Florence ~70–105 min — not a substitute for a live booking. 4. Return rule of thumb: leave inland sights early enough for train + town transfer + port shuttle + explicit buffer (below).

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Leaning Tower & Piazza dei Miracoli, Pisa — tower climbs are timed; 90 min.
Florence Duomo — dome climb requires booking.
Fortezza Vecchia, Livorno — by the old port.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Two different shuttles may operate — one to Piazza del Municipio, one (paid) direct to Livorno Centrale. Pick the right queue on the quay; mixing them up costs 30+ minutes (secondary).
